title: Extension functions String.shout and Int.shout: one moved, the other edited
expected: String.shout moved to the end unchanged (moved); Int.shout edited in place ("!" -> "!!"). The two share a name but not a receiver, so Int.shout must not pair with String.shout.

title: Extension receiver changed from String to CharSequence
expected: Edited: a different receiver type is a different function (and the body changed to toString().uppercase()). Not renamed, even though String -> CharSequence is one identifier swapped on the header line.

title: Extension receiver Int -> Long with matching literal change
expected: Edited: changing the receiver type changes which values the function applies to; never renamed.
old:
package demo

fun String.isBlankish(): Boolean = trim().isEmpty()

fun Int.isEven(): Boolean = this % 2 == 0
new:
package demo

fun String.isBlankish(): Boolean = trim().isEmpty()

fun Long.isEven(): Boolean = this % 2 == 0L

title: Extension property val Int.isEven moved past a same-named Long.isEven
expected: Int.isEven moved to the end unchanged (moved). Long.isEven is a different declaration and is untouched.
old:
package demo

val Int.isEven: Boolean
    get() = this % 2 == 0

val Long.isEven: Boolean
    get() = this % 2L == 0L

fun describe(n: Int): String {
    val kind = if (n.isEven) "even" else "odd"
    return "$n is $kind"
}
new:
package demo

val Long.isEven: Boolean
    get() = this % 2L == 0L

fun describe(n: Int): String {
    val kind = if (n.isEven) "even" else "odd"
    return "$n is $kind"
}

val Int.isEven: Boolean
    get() = this % 2 == 0

title: Member function moved from the class body into its companion object
expected: Edited, never plain moved: fromFahrenheit is now called on the class (Temperature.fromFahrenheit) instead of on an instance, and it loses access to the instance (decided context rule).

title: Function moved out of the companion object into the class body
expected: Edited, never plain moved: startingAt goes from Counter.startingAt(n) to an instance method (decided context rule).

title: Control: a function moved within the companion object
expected: Moved: ofDollars stays in the same companion, so nothing about how it is called changes.

title: Function moved into a named companion object (companion object Factory)
expected: Edited, never plain moved: guest() becomes User.guest() / User.Factory.guest() instead of an instance method.

title: Control: a function moved within a named companion object
expected: Moved: guest() moves to the end of the same companion Factory.

title: Data class primary-constructor parameters reordered
expected: Edited: component1()/component2(), destructuring and positional calls Point(1, 2) now mean the other field. Never moved or reordered.

title: Data class parameters reordered on one line
expected: Edited: Range(0, 10) now sets end=0, start=10. Never reordered, moved or reformatted.
old:
package demo

data class Range(val start: Int, val end: Int)

fun width(r: Range): Int = r.end - r.start
new:
package demo

data class Range(val end: Int, val start: Int)

fun width(r: Range): Int = r.end - r.start

title: Expression body rewritten as a block body with return
expected: Edited, not reformatted: the tokens differ (": Int", braces, return) and the tree shape differs.

title: Extract whose new helper has an expression body
expected: extractedFunction: the items.filter.sumOf chain moved from total() into subtotal() = ..., which returns it; total() now calls subtotal().

title: Inline of a helper with an expression body
expected: inlinedFunction: netAmount() = ... removed and its expression now sits in due() in place of the call.

title: One-line class body class A { val x = 1 } reflowed to three lines
expected: Reformatted: same tokens and same tree, only line breaks and indentation differ.

title: Object body collapsed onto one line
expected: Reformatted: object Defaults { const val PORT = 8080 } has the same tokens as the three-line form.

title: Overloads scale(by: Double) / scale(by: Int): one moved, the other edited
expected: scale(Double) moved to the end unchanged (moved); scale(Int) edited in place (by -> by.toDouble()). Each overload pairs with its own partner, keyed by parameter types.

title: Overload parameter type Int -> Long
expected: Edited: a different parameter type is a different overload (and different callers resolve to it). Never renamed, though Int -> Long is a single identifier swap.

title: Control: top-level function moved to the end of the file
expected: Moved: parseLine is unchanged and still top-level.

title: Function renamed with its call sites (fmt -> formatCents)
expected: Renamed fmt -> formatCents on the declaration and both calls; nothing else changed.

title: Rename fmt -> formatCents that hides a changed argument on one call line
expected: Renamed on lines 3 and 10; line 11 also changed its argument (tax -> tax + total), so it must not be covered by renamed: it stays an edit.
